name: Wit of the Twisting Highway
body:
School transmutation; Level: jester 4

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of the combat, your base speed increases by 10 feet.
